title: Memo on backup retention (fictional)
text: Under section 4, a controller must delete customer records within 90 days of account closure, unless a written legal hold applies. In Arden Logistics v. Corvo Systems, the court held that a retention policy applied to archived backups only if the policy said so expressly. Policy DR-3 states that archived backups are retained for one year. Because Policy DR-3 addresses archived backups expressly, the memo recommends confirming how section 4 applies to those backups before relying on the policy.
